question: Why did APAC's completed revenue fall so much more than other regions' from Q2 to Q3 2025?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_change FROM regions AS r JOIN customers AS c ON c.region_id = r.region_id JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE r.region_name = 'APAC' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY revenue_change ASC LIMIT 500

answer: Assuming the question is addressed by analyzing individual product performance within APAC, the drop in completed revenue from Q2 to Q3 2025 was largely driven by significant declines in Hardware products such as Lattice Ridge, which fell from 116,337.50 to 28,311.17 (a change of -88,026.33), Anchor Summit, which dropped from 87,682.94 to 13,566.04 (a change of -74,116.90), and Cascade Beacon, which decreased from 83,349.45 to 16,166.59 (a change of -67,182.86).
